items.name: Cernay-lès-Reims 2025
items.information:
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReims2025#57650-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). 

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReims2025#57650-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTc4ODMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--28e3c3e3e71e993004b204a76ce4d9c5678b2c19/Untitled%20design%20(4).png)

**Panay Speedcubers**, in partnership with **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** presents the 7th **Visayas Championship 2025**. The first Visayas Championship outside the province of Cebu.

As a regional championship, this competition will recognize the fastest competitors in each respective event residing in Visayas.

* All the necessary information can be found in the tabs above.
* If you are interested in participating, the full registration details can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VisayasChampionship2025#51365-payment-and-registration).
* Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating.
* Please take note that the schedule given is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it.

###### *By participating in this event, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.*

This competition is an integral part of the “Cube Camp” series, organized by ThailandCube.
The third edition of “Cube Camp” will be held in Suan Pheung, Ratchaburi, this year.
“Cube Camp” is a three-day competition that features all World Cube Association (WCA) events, making this an opportunity for every categories you are into!
The competition will be held in a venue that provides food and night accommodations, ensuring a comfortable stay for participants.

**The 2,500 THB registration fees includes:
Competition Fees
2 nights accommodation (9 and 10 August)
2 breakfasts (10 and 11 August)
2 lunches (10 and 11 August)
and 2 dinners (9 and 10 August)**

If you have any companions and want to reserve more room, please contact us, this will cost 2,300 THB per guest.

Please see in tabs for more information.

items.name: Ashfield Summer Challenge 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.
The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition.
